readout.purpose: The note sounding, in the label band; steps down to 29, 23 and 18 px as it has more to say.

headline.purpose: Page and section heads on Measurements and Notes; 25 px on a phone.

body.purpose: Prose on the reading pages, at 33rem.

control.purpose: The rail's words and tooltips; 12.5 px on a phone.

label.purpose: The 11 px floor: names under glyphs, pedals, dials, keys, counts. Tabular.

code.purpose: Equations on Notes and the debug log only.

vector.purpose: Hershey Simplex capitals, only while the vector look shows.

shadows.name: fixture
shadows.purpose: --fixture: the line of light on the upper edge of the chosen thing.

shadows.name: spot
shadows.purpose: --spot: a background, not a shadow: the fixture's light on what stands under it.

shadows.name: fixture-half
shadows.purpose: A section some of whose desks the keys play.

shadows.name: menu
shadows.purpose: A line's instruments, the routing grid, the sheet's parts.

shadows.name: sheet-paper

shadows.name: key-lip

shadows.name: drop

motion.purpose: Light comes up at once: hover, lit, sounding.

components.name: Rail pick (lit and unlit)
components.description: An instrument on the rail: glyph over name. The one on the stage is silver under a fixture and its spot; nothing is boxed.
components.css: .ds-rail { position: relative; display: flex; gap: 1px; height: 60px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--ground, #111315); } .ds-rail::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(245 247 249 / 0.2), rgb(245 247 249 / 0.08) 36%, rgb(245 247 249 / 0.03)); } .ds-pick { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1px; min-width: 40px; padding: 2px 3px 3px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: none; color: var(--muted, #919497); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--face, 'Libre Franklin Variable', 'Franklin Gothic Medium', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.25; transition: color var(--fall, 320ms) var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-pick:hover { color: var(--ink, #e6e8ea); transition-duration: var(--rise, 90ms); } .ds-pick[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--light, #f5f7f9); background: radial-gradient(50% 72% at 50% 0%, rgb(245 247 249 / 0.26), rgb(245 247 249 / 0.08) 55%, transparent 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--light, #f5f7f9); } .ds-pick:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--light, #f5f7f9); outline-offset: -1.5px; }

components.name: View switch
components.description: Words, one of them lit: the view (2D, Vector, 3D) and the piano kind. No segment box.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; align-items: stretch; height: 60px; background: var(--ground, #111315); padding: 0 12px; } .ds-word { border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: none; padding: 0 7px; font-family: var(--face, 'Libre Franklin Variable', 'Franklin Gothic Medium', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1; color: var(--muted, #919497); cursor: pointer; transition: color var(--fall, 320ms) var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-word:hover { color: var(--ink, #e6e8ea); transition-duration: var(--rise, 90ms); } .ds-word[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--light, #f5f7f9); background: radial-gradient(50% 72% at 50% 0%, rgb(245 247 249 / 0.26), rgb(245 247 249 / 0.08) 55%, transparent 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--light, #f5f7f9); } .ds-word:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--light, #f5f7f9); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Readout (the label)
components.description: What is sounding: Franklin Light 34 px in silver over one small tabular line, in a fixed 250 by 58 px box.
components.html:
C3 C4 E4 G4
C major · 130.8 Hz – 392.0 Hz
components.css: .ds-readout { width: 250px; height: 58px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--ground, #111315); } .ds-r-note { height: 38px; font-family: var(--face, 'Libre Franklin Variable', 'Franklin Gothic Medium', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-weight: 300; font-size: 29px; line-height: 38px; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--light, #f5f7f9); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; } .ds-r-hz { height: 15px; margin-top: 4px; font-family: var(--face, 'Libre Franklin Variable', 'Franklin Gothic Medium', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 15px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--muted, #919497); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Dial
components.description: A thin ring with an index: the value is an arc of silver. Name under it, the reading in its place on hover or focus.
components.css: .ds-knob { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; width: 54px; padding: 8px 4px; background: var(--wall-0, #090a0c); cursor: ns-resize; outline: none; font-family: var(--face, 'Libre Franklin Variable', 'Franklin Gothic Medium', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-k-track { fill: none; stroke: rgb(230 232 234 / 0.16); stroke-width: 1.2; } .ds-k-val { fill: none; stroke: var(--light, #f5f7f9); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-k-cap { fill: rgb(230 232 234 / 0.03); stroke: rgb(230 232 234 / 0.3); stroke-width: 0.8; transition: fill var(--fall, 320ms) var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-k-ptr { stroke: var(--light, #f5f7f9); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-k-name { color: var(--muted, #919497); } .ds-k-read { display: none; color: var(--light, #f5f7f9); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-knob:hover .ds-k-cap, .ds-knob:focus-visible .ds-k-cap { fill: rgb(230 232 234 / 0.1); stroke: var(--ink-2, #bbbec1); transition-duration: var(--rise, 90ms); } .ds-knob:focus-visible .ds-k-cap { stroke: var(--light, #f5f7f9); } .ds-knob:hover .ds-k-read, .ds-knob:focus-visible .ds-k-read { display: block; } .ds-knob:hover .ds-k-name, .ds-knob:focus-visible .ds-k-name { display: none; }

components.name: Pedal
components.description: A pedal in outline; held, it fills with light and sinks.
components.css: .ds-pedals { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--wall-0, #090a0c); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(245 247 249 / 0.4); } .ds-pedal { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 2px; width: 46px; padding: 3px 0 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--muted, #919497); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--face, 'Libre Franklin Variable', 'Franklin Gothic Medium', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-pedal path { fill: rgb(245 247 249 / 0.04); stroke: var(--ink-2, #bbbec1); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-pedal:hover path, .ds-pedal:focus-visible path { stroke: var(--light, #f5f7f9); } .ds-pedal:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--light, #f5f7f9); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pedal[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--light, #f5f7f9); } .ds-pedal[aria-pressed="true"] svg { transform: translateY(3px) scaleY(0.9); } .ds-pedal[aria-pressed="true"] path { fill: rgb(245 247 249 / 0.9); stroke: var(--light, #f5f7f9); } .ds-pedal:active svg { transform: translateY(3px) scaleY(0.9); }

components.name: Keys (half-light, sounding)
components.description: Keys stand in half-light under the plinth; a key that sounds is lit. Names in key ink, 11 px.
components.html:
C4
D
E
F
components.css: .ds-keys { position: relative; display: inline-flex; height: 130px; padding: 0 12px 6px; background: var(--wall-0, #090a0c); } .ds-key { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #74777b 0%, var(--key, #a9abae) 9%, #b3b5b8 76%, var(--key, #a9abae) 100%); background-clip: padding-box; border: solid transparent; border-width: 0 0.5px; border-radius: 0 0 2px 2px; box-shadow: inset 0 -4px 0 var(--key-lip, #7e8084); transition: transform 0.04s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-key:active { transform: translateY(2px); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #8e9195 0%, #c5c7ca 12%, #d1d3d6 100%); background-clip: padding-box; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--key-lip, #7e8084); } .ds-key.ds-on { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #bcbfc3 0%, var(--light, #f5f7f9) 14%, #fff 100%); background-clip: padding-box; box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 #cfd2d6; } .ds-key span { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 12px; text-align: center; font-family: var(--face, 'Libre Franklin Variable', 'Franklin Gothic Medium', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; color: var(--key-ink, #202225); } .ds-bk { position: absolute; top: 0; width: 22px; height: 62%; margin-left: 12px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #030405 0%, #0d0e10 68%, #202226 91%, #08090b 100%); border-radius: 0 0 2px 2px; box-shadow: inset 0 -5px 0 #000, 0 3px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7); }

components.name: File player
components.description: Icons on a strip of the wall's own tone, and a hairline for the place: the part played in light.
components.css: .ds-player { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 3px 4px; border-radius: var(--radius, 2px); background: rgb(17 19 21 / 0.84); } .ds-pl-btn { width: 28px; height: 28px; padding: 5px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius, 2px); background: none; color: var(--ink-2, #bbbec1); cursor: pointer; transition: color var(--fall, 320ms) var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-pl-btn:hover { color: var(--light, #f5f7f9); transition-duration: var(--rise, 90ms); } .ds-pl-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--light, #f5f7f9); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pl-btn svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; fill: currentColor; } .ds-pl-bar { position: relative; width: 160px; height: 1px; background: rgb(230 232 234 / 0.24); } .ds-pl-bar i { position: absolute; inset: -0.5px 0; background: var(--light, #f5f7f9); transform-origin: left; transform: scaleX(0.38); }

components.name: Menu (pieces)
components.description: What floats over the stage: raised wall, a hairline frame, 2 px corners, a soft shadow. Title first, then who wrote it.
components.css: .ds-menu { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 280px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-2, #3d4043); border-radius: var(--radius, 2px); background: var(--wall-2, #1a1c1f); box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55); } .ds-mi { display: grid; gap: 3px; padding: 7px 8px 5px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius, 2px); background: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--face, 'Libre Franklin Variable', 'Franklin Gothic Medium', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-mi b { font-weight: 500; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.005em; color: var(--ink, #e6e8ea); } .ds-mi span { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--muted, #919497); } .ds-mi:hover, .ds-mi:focus-visible { background: rgb(230 232 234 / 0.08); outline: none; }

components.name: Stage knob (room)
components.description: A dial on a disc of the floor's tone, on the stage itself: no word and no pointer; the arc is the value and the middle shows what it moves.
components.css: .ds-sk { display: inline-block; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; cursor: ns-resize; outline: none; } .ds-sk svg { display: block; } .ds-sk-bg { fill: rgb(9 10 12 / 0.78); stroke: rgb(230 232 234 / 0.2); stroke-width: 0.8; transition: stroke var(--fall, 320ms) var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-sk-track { fill: none; stroke: rgb(230 232 234 / 0.2); stroke-width: 1.2; } .ds-sk-val { fill: none; stroke: var(--light, #f5f7f9); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-sk-glyph { fill: none; stroke: var(--ink-2, #bbbec1); stroke-width: 1.3; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-sk:hover .ds-sk-bg, .ds-sk:focus-visible .ds-sk-bg, .ds-sk:hover .ds-sk-glyph, .ds-sk:focus-visible .ds-sk-glyph { stroke: var(--light, #f5f7f9); transition-duration: var(--rise, 90ms); }

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: An icon-only control's name and value: one line, lower case, one grammar.
components.css: .ds-tip { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-2, #3d4043); border-radius: var(--radius, 2px); font-family: var(--face, 'Libre Franklin Variable', 'Franklin Gothic Medium', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-weight: 500; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.3; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--ink, #e6e8ea); background: var(--wall-2, #1a1c1f); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
The instrument is the one lit object in a museum room after closing, and the page is that room: its wall, its picture rail, its label, its plinth. A cool charcoal wall runs edge to edge; the floor is one step darker. At the top a rail carries sixteen line-drawn glyphs in their families; under it a wall label names what is sounding; below stands the work itself, the only colour on the page; at the foot a matt plinth with a lit front edge, and the keys in half-light.
 Light is the only signal. What is chosen, pressed or sounding is lit, never coloured and never boxed. There are three lights and no paint: silver (the light from behind; every "on"), tungsten (the dim key; what a body does: a board, a string that answers, a hammer's speed), steel (reference: the recording a model is held against). All other colour belongs to the instruments: their wood, brass, felt, copper and steel.
 It is quiet, spare and exact: one grotesque family, tight tracking, low-contrast labels that still pass AA, square corners, no ornament. It replaced a dark product studio under softboxes with an italic display serif over small monospace labels and one orange accent; none of that is current, and none of it returns.
keyCharacteristics: One wall tone for page, 2D stage and 3D room; they meet without a seam (`--ground` is read by the 3D stage).
Three lights, no paint. One alarm colour, for a failure and nothing else.
One way to say "this one": a fixture on the rail's upper edge and its light falling on the thing.
One family, Libre Franklin, with tabular figures from its fork Public Sans; text floor 11 px.
Hairlines only where something stands: the rail's lower line, the plinth's front edge, the floor line.
Light rises in 90 ms and falls in 320 ms. Nothing changes place but what the hand moves.
The stage is nearly wordless: icon-only controls carry a tooltip and an accessible name.

rules.name: The Three Lights Rule
rules.body: Silver, tungsten, steel, and no paint. A new state gets one of the three by its meaning (on, a body's doing, reference), never a new hue.

rules.name: The Instruments' Colour Rule
rules.body: Any saturated colour on the page belongs to an instrument's material. Chrome never borrows it.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: `signal` appears only when the sound has failed.

rules.name: The Slot Exception
rules.body: In vector lines only, the first four knobs of an instrument take a slot colour (green `vector-slot-1`, red `-2`, pink `-3`, white `-4`; blue past the fourth) and whatever each knob moves in the drawing is drawn in that colour. It ties a control to its effect; it is not decoration and does not exist in the other two looks.

rules.name: The Blue Pencil Exception
rules.body: On the sheet music's paper light cannot be the mark, so the notes sounding and the place line are `sheet-on`. In vector lines the same role is amber.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Libre Franklin for everything that is read. No second display face, no monospace labels.

rules.name: The Figures Rule
rules.body: Anything that changes while it is read (a frequency, a reading, a count, a table) is tabular.

rules.name: The Hershey Exception
rules.body: In vector lines `--face` becomes Hershey Simplex, upper-cased with 0.03–0.04em tracking, weight 500 (300 for the readout). It is a second drawing of the same room, not a second voice in the first.

rules.name: The Light From Behind Rule
rules.body: The instrument is cut out by silver light from behind and read by a dim tungsten key. Never fill from the front; never a softbox.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: Rail, label and plinth carry no shadow. A shadow means "this floats over the stage".

rules.name: The One Wall Rule
rules.body: Page, 2D ground and 3D far wall are the same tone and meet without a seam.

rules.name: The Standing Line Rule
rules.body: A hairline is drawn only where something stands on it: the index on the rail, the work on the floor, the plinth's edge. Never a divider between siblings; a gap says that.

dos: Do say a state with light: silver ink, and where there is a rail above it, `--fixture` and `--spot`.
Do take every chrome colour from the tokens, and every 2D drawing ink from `INK`; in vector lines from `V`, masking solids with `GROUND`.
Do keep text at 11px or more, tabular wherever it changes while read, in Libre Franklin.
Do keep the page, the 2D ground and the 3D far wall one tone, and let the 3D stage read `--ground`.
Do light the 3D instrument from behind in silver with a dim tungsten key, and let its shadow fall forward.
Do time light at 90 ms up and 320 ms down on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`; transition colour and opacity, not place.
Do give an icon-only control a `data-tip` and an `aria-label`, and a dial a real slider.
Do give a touch target 44px where the layout has room (stage knobs, the knob toggle, the octave's arrows at 40×44, Notes' contents), and never widen the page to fit a long lineup.
Do honour reduced motion: the lamp stops breathing and every transition is instant.
donts: Don't mark "this one" with a colour, a filled chip, a boxed segment, an underline or a side stripe.

Don't bring back the look this replaced: a warm near-black ground, an italic display serif over small monospace labels, a vermilion or amber accent, softboxes and a warm key in a product studio, a spot in a void.
Don't add a second family, or set labels in monospace. Never Inter, Instrument Serif, Fraunces, Bricolage Grotesque, Space Grotesk, Sora, Young Serif, Bodoni, Geist or Syne.
Don't use tungsten or steel to mean "selected", or `signal` for anything but a failure.
Don't use the vector slot colours, the blue pencil or the Hershey face outside the look or surface they belong to.
Don't put a shadow, a frame or a blur on the rail, the label or the plinth; don't blur behind anything.
Don't draw a divider between siblings; don't round a corner past 2px unless the thing is round.
Don't add permanent words to the stage, or a theme picker.
Don't fill the 3D scene from the front or raise the environment to read a dark body; give it an edge to catch.
